title: Provider-neutral agent runner seam + dsh adapter
summary: Introduces a provider-neutral harness interface (`AgentRunner`/`CommandRunner` traits, task/result/capability types, prompt and QUESTION-line contract) plus in-memory fakes, and the first concrete adapter, `DshAgentRunner`, which drives `dsh --profile headless --json -` through a `CommandRunner`, parses newline-delimited JSON events, and brackets each run with git status/head/branch probes using a credential-free git environment. A new `job-blocked` journal payload carries a clarification question out of a run. Tests and recorded `dsh` fixtures pin the parsing and capability behaviour.

lanes.label: Factory core
lanes.subtitle: osf crate
lanes.summary: The existing factory code the new seam plugs into: the journal and the reviewer environment allow-list.

lanes.label: Harness seam
lanes.subtitle: agent_runner
lanes.summary: Provider-neutral traits and plain data types that name no harness, command or model vendor.

lanes.label: dsh adapter
lanes.subtitle: dsh_agent_runner
lanes.summary: The first concrete AgentRunner: builds commands, parses events, and enforces the run contract.

lanes.label: Process boundary
lanes.subtitle: child processes
lanes.summary: The real command runner and the external tools it starts: the dsh binary and git.

nodes.label: Journal
nodes.subtitle: Payload enum + replay
nodes.summary: Append-only event log. Gains a `JobBlocked` payload variant carrying job, work item, cause and an optional question, and passes it through replay unchanged.

nodes.label: Reviewer env allow-list
nodes.subtitle: RUN_ENV_VARS
nodes.summary: The list of environment names safe to pass to a reviewer process. Widened from private to crate-visible so the dsh adapter can reuse it as the git environment allow-list.

nodes.label: AgentRunner trait
nodes.subtitle: run / capabilities
nodes.summary: The seam between the factory and an external coding harness. `run` takes a `CommandRunner` and an `AgentTask`; `capabilities` probes what the harness can do. Object-safe.

nodes.label: CommandRunner trait
nodes.subtitle: run(CommandSpec)
nodes.summary: Runs exactly one command with its own environment, workdir, stdin and timeout. The only way an adapter reaches a process.

nodes.label: Task / result / capability types
nodes.subtitle: AgentTask, AgentRunResult, Capability
nodes.summary: Plain serializable data for the journal: task, actor, usage, outcome (finished or asked), changed files, branch, head commit, and the eight capability states.

nodes.label: Prompt + QUESTION contract
nodes.subtitle: build_prompt / question_line
nodes.summary: Builds the task prompt with the four rules appended, and reads a trailing `QUESTION:` line from a final message as the clarification signal.

nodes.label: FakeRunner / FakeAgentRunner
nodes.subtitle: in-memory doubles
nodes.summary: Replay scripted answers and record every command and task as plain data; start no process.

nodes.label: DshAgentRunner
nodes.subtitle: AgentRunner impl
nodes.summary: Rejects empty tasks and dirty trees, snapshots head and branch, runs dsh, parses events, checks the head did not move, and maps a QUESTION line to an asked outcome.

nodes.label: Command builders
nodes.subtitle: build_command / status / head / branch
nodes.summary: Pure functions that produce the dsh run command and the git status, head and branch commands, each with its own environment.

nodes.label: Event parser
nodes.subtitle: parse_events / parse_changed_files
nodes.summary: Reads newline-delimited JSON events into session id, final message, summed usage and the first non-completed turn reason; reads NUL-separated git status into sorted changed paths.

nodes.label: Capability probes
nodes.subtitle: version / headless / dump-config
nodes.summary: Probes `--version`, the headless help and the profile dump, reporting each capability as supported, unsupported or unknown rather than assuming.

nodes.label: RealCommandRunner
nodes.subtitle: child process + timeout
nodes.summary: Clears the environment, starts the child as its own process-group leader, drains both pipes on threads, and kills the whole tree at the deadline.

nodes.label: dsh binary
nodes.subtitle: --profile headless --json -
nodes.summary: The external coding harness. Reads the prompt on stdin and writes newline-delimited JSON events to stdout.

nodes.label: git
nodes.subtitle: status / rev-parse
nodes.summary: Reads the working tree state, head commit and branch. Reached with only PATH, HOME and GIT_* names, so no credential reaches it.

edges.label: implements
edges.summary: The dsh adapter is the first implementation of the neutral seam.

edges.label: runs every command
edges.summary: The adapter starts no process itself; every dsh and git command goes through the runner.

edges.label: JobBlocked payload
edges.summary: An asked outcome becomes a `job-blocked` event with cause `clarification` and the question text.
